action.name: Vendor Auto to Smart Curve to Fixed 2200 to Auto sequence
action.value: Operator-confirmed rapid Smart Fan Curve and Fixed 2200 selections followed by Auto restoration

validation.applyResult: Applied successfully in Synapse: the operator selected Smart Fan Curve and then Fixed 2200; each action emitted an acknowledged 0D/10 command.
validation.readbackResult: Vendor response successful: both commands returned status-02 exact semantic echoes. No independent active-mode or tachometer getter exists.
validation.restorationResult: Restored successfully in Synapse: Auto emitted the captured 0D/10 handback command with a status-02 exact semantic echo.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Restoration was operator-confirmed in Synapse and transport-acknowledged; no active-mode readback was available.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The operator's first rapid selection was Smart Fan Curve; Synapse emitted 0D/10 payload 01022C and received a status-02 exact echo.
The operator then selected Fixed 2200; Synapse emitted the same 0D/10 payload 01022C and received a status-02 exact echo.
The operator restored Auto; Synapse emitted 0D/10 payload 000600 and received a status-02 exact echo.

limitations: The operator clarified that the two 01022C commands were two separate rapid UI actions, first Smart Fan Curve and then Fixed 2200. They are not evidence of a retry policy.
Both rapid selections emitted the same 0D/10 semantic payload, so this capture alone does not distinguish the pad's persistent active-mode state after those actions.
Synapse exposes no fan-speed readback. The configured-target getter is commanded state only, and the candidate current-speed getter fails protocol validation.
The Auto command is an acknowledged vendor handback, but no independent active-mode getter confirms the resulting firmware ownership state.
The transient USB device address is capture-local and must not be used as production identity.
No OpenBlade pad fan write was performed in this capture. The raw PCAP remains local and uncommitted.

productionAdmission.reason: The exact vendor setters and status-02 echoes are captured, but a typed OpenBlade apply/restore and independent active-mode readback remain incomplete.

notes: The capture selected only the exact pad's transient address on the complete shared USB root.
OpenBlade service was stopped before capture and restarted after a graceful stop.
The operator's final pad state was Auto.
